body:
> In my opinion, the usual `dot(c, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));` code should be used.

you probably actually want to use the srgb/rec709 coefficients for this, i.e. `vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)`

this will also be wrong for the case of rec2020 (hdr) output, but godot doesn't support that and even in that case it'll be less wrong than what's currently there
